Description: One or more correlated signals (CorrelatedHosts, FSLogixCorrelation) detected multi-dimensional degradation.
One or more disk-health signals (DiskQueueLength, DiskFreeSpace) breached thresholds.
FSLogix profile attach/detach failures or VHD errors detected in operational/admin event logs.
GPU encoding time exceeds the 33ms RDP frame budget on GPU-enabled session hosts.
One or more host-performance signals (CPU, Memory, MemoryCommit, Pages, PageFaults, DiskTiming) breached thresholds.
One or more session-lifecycle signals (SignInDegradation, CapacityPressure, SessionImbalance) breached thresholds.
One or more session-quality signals (InputDelay, RoundTripLatency, UDPBandwidth) breached thresholds.
